name: Butethal
summary: Butobarbital, also called butobarbitone or butethal, Soneryl, and Neonal, is a hypnotic drug which is a barbiturate derivative. It was developed by Poulenc Brothers (now part of Sanofi) in 1921.

uses.text: It was developed by Poulenc Brothers (now part of Sanofi) in 1921.

pharmacology.en: Like other barbiturates, it binds the GABA-A receptor and holds its chloride channel open for longer, which damps brain activity and causes sedation and sleep.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他巴比妥類一樣，它與 GABA-A 受體結合並使其氯離子通道開啟更久，從而抑制腦部活動，造成鎮靜與睡眠。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他巴比妥类一样，它与 GABA-A 受体结合并使其氯离子信道打开更久，从而抑制脑部活动，造成镇静与睡眠。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and confusion. Overdose can stop breathing and be fatal. Regular use brings tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause seizures that can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與混亂。過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，突然停藥可能引起危及生命的癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与混乱。过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，突然停药可能引起危及生命的癫痫发作。

fact.en: It was developed by the Poulenc Brothers in France in 1921, a company that later became part of Sanofi, and was sold as Soneryl for sleeplessness.
fact.zh: 丁巴比妥由法國 Poulenc 兄弟公司於 1921 年開發，該公司後來成為賽諾菲的一部分，它曾以 Soneryl 之名販售治療失眠。
fact.zhHans: 丁巴比妥由法国 Poulenc 兄弟公司于 1921 年开发，该公司后来成为赛诺菲的一部分，它曾以 Soneryl 之名贩售治疗失眠。
